units.source_text: 名人辞世那年的正月初二，就是逝世前半个月，他参加了日本棋院的棋赛开幕式，并下了连棋。

en.t: On the second day of the New Year in the year the Master died, just half a month before his death, he attended the opening ceremony of a tournament at the Nihon Ki-in and played a consultation game.

units.source_text: 做法是：这天来棋院的棋手，只要找到对手，各自下五手就回去，以此代替留下祝贺的名片。

en.t: The custom was this: on that day, the players who came to the Ki-in would find an opponent, each play five moves, and then go home, using that in place of leaving a congratulatory calling card.

units.source_text: 排队等候的时间很长，只好另开一盘。

en.t: The wait in line was very long, so they had no choice but to start another game.

units.source_text: 这第二盘棋进行到二十手时，濑尾初段闲极无聊，名人就找他下起来。

en.t: When this second game had reached twenty moves, Seo, a shodan, was bored with nothing to do, so the Master asked him to play.

units.source_text: 从二十一手到三十手，各下了五手。

en.t: From the twenty-first move to the thirtieth, each of them played five moves.

units.source_text: 这局棋已经没有棋手后继了。

en.t: By then there were no more players left to continue this game.

units.source_text: 轮到名人下最后一手就中途暂停，结束了。

en.t: When it came time for the Master to play the final move, the game was suspended midway and came to an end.

units.source_text: 这30的最后一手，名人思考了四十分钟。

en.t: For that last move, the thirtieth, the Master thought for forty minutes.

units.source_text: 其实，这只不过是开幕式的即席助兴，又没有人续弈，随便下下就成。

en.t: In fact, it was only an impromptu diversion for the opening ceremony, and since no one was going to continue the game, he could simply have played casually.
